description: Add groceries to the Harris Teeter cart by UPC. Adds to any quantity already in the cart. Reversible with ht_update_cart_item / ht_remove_from_cart; nothing is ordered or charged.

substitutionPolicy.description: If the item is out of stock: SHOPPER_CHOICE (default — the shopper picks a similar item), CUSTOMER_CHOICE, CONTACT_CUSTOMER, or NONE (no substitute).

name: ht_add_to_cart
